errors.evidence: The legend label is 'Zuflüssen' (inflows), not 'Zufällen' (coincidences/chances). This error is repeated later in the description.
The y-axis has labeled tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points (e.g., -1, 1, 3, 5), not 1%.
The blue dashed line, representing the average, has an explicit label of '6,3' (6.3%) in the chart. The described value of 5.8% is incorrect.
In 2014, the purple line dips to a value slightly below 0%, not 0.3%.
In 2021, the purple line (share of inflows) is at approximately 2%, not 5.9%.
The purple line ends in 2024 at a value very close to 0%, not 1.4%.
The purple dashed line, representing the average, has an explicit label of '2,6' (2.6%) in the chart. The described value of 1.7% is incorrect.
